US To Sell $92 Bln In Reopened 3-Month Bills Tue
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $92 billion in reopened 3-month bills Tuesday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 10, 2026 and will mature Dec. 10, 2026.
The debt is a reopening of an issue first sold on June 11, 2026.
The Federal Reserve holds $18.898 billion of maturing securities for its own account. Amounts bid by the Federal Reserve banks for their own account will be in addition to the public offering amount.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 3-month bills, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:00 AM Eastern Time Tuesday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:30 AM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
